smell: Detector candidate: FieldOption defaults its value type to broad string and uses React.ReactNode for labels.

exception.reason: FieldOption is a public UI option interface shared by select/radio/toggle components. The concrete form schema owns the selected value domain; this interface only carries renderable labels and caller-provided option values.

exception.reason: These are React-facing props for field components and are explicitly carved out by the package instructions. Field value precision is supplied by the caller's effect schema passed into TanStack form options.

smell: Detector candidate: the package does not define S.toArbitrary laws around the schemas it receives.

exception.reason: toFormSchema is a generic adapter from caller-owned effect schemas to TanStack's Standard Schema contract. The caller schema owns precision and round-trip laws; @beep/form's own tests correctly exercise adapter behavior with small representative schemas.
